args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Based on the vacation itinerary for Hawaii (June 10-20, 2024), here are the essential items to pack:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and general activities)
- Camera (to capture memories at all the beautiful locations)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, hotel reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel and beach bag
- Snorkeling gear (optional - can be rented)
- Hiking shoes or sturdy sandals
- Light rain jacket (for unexpected tropical showers)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Formal attire (for the Luau experience)

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Portable charger for electronics
- Reusable water bottle
